name: Class beat facts
notes: Set once when a class beat's text has been shown in the game (mw-aw1y), so a save and load does not show it again. Keyed by the beat id of narration-class-beats.json. Only beats with a built trigger have a fact; the rest are bound by beads (docs/narrative/class-beat-audit.md).

facts.description: The class's own way into the Deepworks text has been shown (shown when the player takes that class's way in).
The class's Wendmouth text has been shown (shown on first reaching Wendmouth, wendmouth.visited).
